correctness.rationale: For common exactly-t descendants in a positional alignment, source deletions spoil at most t blocks and target deletions in internal matched gaps spoil at most t additional blocks. Thus one full source block occurs consecutively in the other power when r≥2t+1. Its first matched positions differ by the difference of the preceding deletion counts and hence by at most t, giving the claimed signed phase shift. Conversely, the common unchanged overlap at a phase shift s has length rm−|s| and can be shortened to rm−t. The observation remains a linear word. At least period d each orbit is a labeled cycle-power conflict graph: the maximum independent set has gaps at least t+1 for two or more selected points, yielding the floor when feasible and one otherwise. For d>t, marking a chosen vertex, counting the ordered excess gaps and dividing by k counts each maximal-size set exactly once; for d≤t the only choices are singletons. Primitive-period Möbius inversion supplies the orbit counts. Proper periods contribute at most Σ_{d|m,d<m}q^d=O(mq^(m/2)) messages, so the full-length term proves the claimed limit. The up-to-t consequence uses further deletion of a common descendant of length at least rm−t.
correctness.replay: python3 /tmp/opencode/frozen_nov24_replay.py 2; computed exact LCS by dynamic programming for 6,606 message pairs across seven families, including extra repetition and t=3,4. Separately enumerated orbit-level independent sets to check component capacities and maximizing counts and obtained the eight stated binary capacities. The frozen script was inspected but not run.
residual_risks: The repetition threshold is sufficient; sharpness is not established or needed. The independent finite calculations corroborate only their listed ranges.

value.rationale: For a natural redundancy encoder, the theorem resolves exactly which messages stay confusable despite extra repetitions. The graph result gives constructive optimum selection and the count of optimum labeled subcodes; the exact penalty tends to a nontrivial fraction determined by the deletion budget. The value is the channel-specific structure, not the known cycle-power enumerator by itself.
residual_risks: Restricted encoder family only, not a bound on all deletion-correcting codes of length rm.
